解析：设

\[
L=\lim_{x\to+\infty}\left[\frac{x^n}{(x-1)(x-2)\cdots(x-n)}\right]^x
\]

则

\[
\ln L=\lim_{x\to+\infty}x\ln\left[\frac{x^n}{(x-1)(x-2)\cdots(x-n)}\right]
\]

而

\[
\frac{x^n}{(x-1)(x-2)\cdots(x-n)}
=\prod_{k=1}^n \frac{x}{x-k}
=\prod_{k=1}^n \frac{1}{1-\frac{k}{x}}
\]

所以

\[
\ln\left[\frac{x^n}{(x-1)\cdots(x-n)}\right]
=-\sum_{k=1}^n \ln\left(1-\frac{k}{x}\right)
\]

当 \(x\to+\infty\) 时，有

\[
-\ln\left(1-\frac{k}{x}\right)=\frac{k}{x}+o\left(\frac{1}{x}\right)
\]

因此

\[
x\ln\left[\frac{x^n}{(x-1)\cdots(x-n)}\right]
=x\sum_{k=1}^n\left[\frac{k}{x}+o\left(\frac{1}{x}\right)\right]
\]

\[
=\sum_{k=1}^n k+o(1)
\]

于是

\[
\ln L=\sum_{k=1}^n k=\frac{n(n+1)}{2}
\]

所以

\[
L=e^{\frac{n(n+1)}{2}}
\]

答案：C
